如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    林逸微微一笑点了点头，和楚鹏展自然的握了握手。
这种正常的社交礼仪，林逸很是应付自如：“楚先生，您好！”
楚鹏展的热情，让林逸有些受宠若惊，头一次遇到这么热情的雇主呢。
虽然说自己是被他请来去执行某一项任务的，但是一个上市企业的董事长对自己如此，这让林逸有些好奇，怎么感觉像是同级别的会见呢？
“林先生！我也知道，或许让你屈尊去做这些事情让你有些为难……”
楚鹏展犹豫了一下，说道。
听着楚鹏展越说越离谱了，连脸皮如林逸如此厚的人都有些不好意思了，忙道：
“不屈尊……我在家里编草鞋一个月才赚几百块，老头子说这个任务够我吃一辈子了……”
林逸心道，这雇主好厚道啊，请自己来做事，还这么客气，不像有的人，给了自己报酬，就开始说三道四。
“什么？编草鞋？”
楚鹏展一愣，仔细看了看林逸，自己也没认错人啊？不过这家伙说的都是什么跟什么啊？难道林老每天叫他编草鞋赚那几百块钱？
楚鹏展有些无语了，他从自家老爷子那里也隐约听说了一些关于林逸的事迹，单单那次去非洲营救人质的酬金应该就是上亿美金计的，他居然会编草鞋赚钱？
“是啊，一双草鞋能卖四块钱，一天编个三五双，一个月就是好几百了。”
林逸点了点头，他自己也隐隐的觉得有些不对劲儿，老头子似乎不像是个穷鬼啊？
楚鹏展也管不了人家的私事，听了林逸的话，只得无奈的摇了摇头。
“以后你的工资是每个月三万块，这些钱包含你上学的学费和日常花销，当然，花在我女儿身上的钱，可以额外找李福报销。”
“三万？老头子不说几千块么？”
林逸愣了一下，不是吧？这么高薪？
早知道这样还带什么钱来啊，省的看老头子那副肉疼的嘴脸了，林逸想起了从老头子那里要这四万九千块钱时的情景了：“等等，楚先生，您刚才说什么？上学？学杂费？还有花在您女儿身上的钱？这是什么意思？我有点儿不明白……”
林逸很纳闷，楚鹏展说的到底是什么意思，自己不是来执行任务的么？

“哦？怎么，林老爷子之前没和你说么？请这边来，具体情况，我们去楼上谈吧。”
楚鹏展微微一笑，做出了一个请的姿势，和林逸肩并肩的向电梯走去。
怎么说现在楚鹏展也是自己的雇主了，况且给自己的薪水还真不低，虽然对于楚鹏展所说的事情有些莫名其妙，不过这些年千奇百怪的任务林逸也遇见过不少。
所以，林逸和楚鹏展一起走的时候，特意的放慢了步子，让自己变成跟在他的身后的样子，不过楚鹏展却是很刻意的和林逸的步调保持一致。
林逸自然看在眼里，心下有些诧异，怎么感觉楚鹏展对自己的态度有些过于的亲和了呢？
林逸虽然奇怪，但是却也没有出言询问。
毕竟他是第一次和楚鹏展见面，两人并不是很熟悉，有些话不好说的太多，等到时间长了，自然会搞清楚的。
楚鹏展的办公室坐落在鹏展大厦的顶层，有二百平米之大，一面墙都是大大的落地窗，让屋子里的光线格外明亮。
福伯在将楚鹏展和林逸让进了办公室后，就退了出去，吩咐外面秘书室的秘书小于进去给倒茶了。
“林先生，请问您喝点儿什么？”
小于已经从福伯的口中知道了林逸的姓氏。
“白开水吧。”
林逸平时在家里喝的最多的就是白开水了，出来也是一样。
小于一愣，不过还是微笑的道：“好的，请稍等。”
至于楚董事长喝什么，她不需要询问就知道了，因为每天都是一样的。
“林先生，从明天开始，福伯会安排你进入松山第一高中的高三五班，成为一名高中生，和小女楚梦瑶一个班级，每天同她一起上学、放学，照顾她的生活，回家后指导她的功课……说白了，其实就是和她做个伴儿……我这些年忙于生意，对小女疏于照顾，心存愧疚，我想找个和她谈得来的人，多给她些关怀……这才是我找你来的真正原因……你和她差不多大，都是年轻人，应该有共同话题吧？”
楚鹏展微微一笑说道。
林逸有些发愣，什么找个谈的来的人？
还给她关怀？共同话题？不会吧？

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Lin Yi smiled slightly, nodded, and shook hands with Chu Pengzhan naturally.
Lin Yi was very comfortable with this kind of normal social etiquette: "Hello, Mr. Chu!"
Lin Yi was flattered by Chu Pengzhan's enthusiasm. It was the first time he met such an enthusiastic employer.
Although he said that he was invited by him to perform a certain task, the chairman of a listed company treated him like this. This made Lin Yi a little curious. Why did it feel like a meeting of the same level?
"Mr. Lin! I also know that it may be a little embarrassing for you to condescend to do these things..."
Chu Pengzhan hesitated and said.
Listening to Chu Pengzhan's words, he became more and more outrageous. Even a person as thick-skinned as Lin Yi felt a little embarrassed and said hurriedly:
"I'm not condescending... I only earn a few hundred yuan a month by knitting straw sandals at home. The old man said that this task will last me a lifetime..."
Lin Yi thought to himself, this employer is so kind. He asked me to do the work, and he was so polite. It was unlike some people who started making irresponsible remarks after paying themselves.
"What? Knitting straw sandals?"
Chu Pengzhan was stunned and looked at Lin Yi carefully. He didn't recognize the wrong person? But what is this guy talking about? Could it be that Mr. Lin asked him to make hundreds of dollars by knitting straw sandals every day?
Chu Pengzhan was speechless. He also vaguely heard some stories about Lin Yi from his old man. The reward for that trip to Africa to rescue the hostages alone should have been hundreds of millions of dollars. He could actually make money by knitting straw sandals?
"Yes, a pair of straw sandals can be sold for four yuan. If you make three to five pairs a day, you can make hundreds of dollars a month."
Lin Yi nodded. He also vaguely felt that something was wrong. The old man didn't seem like a poor man?
Chu Pengzhan couldn't care about other people's private affairs. After listening to Lin Yi's words, he had no choice but to shake his head.
"From now on, your salary will be 30,000 yuan per month. This money covers your school fees and daily expenses. Of course, the money spent on my daughter can be reimbursed by Li Fu."
"Thirty thousand? Didn't the old man say a few thousand?"
Lin Yi was stunned for a moment, right? Such a high salary?
If I had known, I would have brought so much money, so I would have saved myself from looking at the old man's painful expression. Lin Yi remembered the scene when he asked for the 49,000 yuan from the old man: "Wait a minute, Mr. Chu, what did you just say? Schooling? Tuition and miscellaneous fees? And money spent on your daughter? What does this mean? I don't understand a little bit..."
Lin Yi was very confused, what exactly did Chu Pengzhan mean? Wasn't he here to perform a mission?
"Oh? Why, didn't Mr. Lin tell you before? Please come here. Let's go upstairs to discuss the specific situation."
Chu Pengzhan smiled slightly, made a gesture of invitation, and walked side by side to the elevator with Lin Yi.
After all, Chu Pengzhan is also his employer now, and the salary given to him is really not low. Although he is a little baffled by what Chu Pengzhan said, Lin Yi has encountered many strange tasks over the years.
Therefore, when Lin Yi walked with Chu Pengzhan, he deliberately slowed down his pace so that he seemed to be following behind him. However, Chu Pengzhan deliberately kept pace with Lin Yi.
Lin Yi naturally saw this and was a little surprised. Why did he feel that Chu Pengzhan's attitude toward him was too friendly?
Although Lin Yi was surprised, he didn't ask any questions.
After all, this was the first time he met Chu Pengzhan. The two were not very familiar with each other. It was hard to say too much about some things. After a long time, they would naturally figure it out.
Chu Pengzhan's office is located on the top floor of Pengzhan Building. It is 200 square meters in size. One wall is covered with large floor-to-ceiling windows, which makes the light in the room particularly bright.
After letting Chu Pengzhan and Lin Yi into the office, Uncle Fu withdrew.Go and ask the secretary in the secretarial room outside to go in and pour tea.
"Mr. Lin, what would you like to drink?"
Yu Yu already knew Lin Yi's surname from Uncle Fu.
"Just boiled water."
Lin Yi usually drinks boiled water the most at home, and the same thing happens when he goes out.
Yu Yu was stunned for a moment, but still smiled and said: "Okay, please wait a moment."
As for what Chairman Chu drinks, she knows without asking because it is the same every day.
"Mr. Lin, starting from tomorrow, Uncle Fu will arrange for you to enter Class 3 and Class 5 of Songshan No. 1 High School. You will become a high school student in the same class as your little daughter Chu Mengyao. You will go to and from school with her every day, take care of her life, and guide her in her homework when she returns home... To put it bluntly, this is actually the case. Be her companion... I have been busy with business these years and have neglected my daughter, and I feel guilty. I want to find someone who can talk to her and give her more care... This is the real reason why I came to you... You are about the same age as her, and we are both young people. We should have something in common, right? "
Chu Pengzhan said with a slight smile.
Lin Yi was in a daze, why would he find someone he could talk to?
Give her some care? Common topic? No way?
